description: Installation of a 15m Telecommunications Monopole with associated equipment cabinets and ancillary works
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Cover letter], [002], [100], [150], [215], [255], [304], [305], [306], [Councils & Conectivity], [Declaration of conformity with ICNIRP Public Exposure Guidelines], [MHCLG Statement], [5G Site Specific Supplementary Information and Planning Justification Statement], [Developers Notice], Received: 07/09/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Once the hereby approved telecommunications mast is no longer required. The apparatus must be removed and the site restored to the condition prior to the development, no later than one month after the mast is no longer required.
